subject: Money
title: Money in Buckets
description: A fast breakdown of Money in Buckets for builders.

hook.text: You won't touch your savings but you'll blow a $500 tax refund. Same money, different mental label.

buildup.text: Richard Thaler discovered mental accounting: we sort money into invisible categories and treat each differently.

discovery.text: A dollar is a dollar. But 'vacation money' feels different from 'rent money' even in the same account.

twist.text: Mental accounting can help: labeled savings jars work because the label creates commitment.

climax.text: The bias is irrational but powerful. Smart systems exploit it: envelope budgeting uses labels on purpose.

punchline.text: Label your money. It changes behavior.
